_about: Editable assumptions used by Gold Lens. These are choices, not exchange rules or facts. Change a value and restart the server.

min_traded_value_lakh.unit: INR lakh traded on the day (100 lakh = Rs 1 crore)
min_traded_value_lakh.why: Below this a contract is treated as thin and is never shown as tradeable. Traded value is used because lot sizes differ (1 g to 100 g).

min_volume_lots.why: A contract with no trades has only a nominal closing price.

min_open_interest_lots.why: No open interest means no one holds the contract.

expiry_buffer_days.why: Contracts this close to expiry are excluded. The official MCX tender period is the last 3 trading days (current specifications); the 7 calendar days add a margin for delivery-driven trading before it starts.

max_expiry_gap_days.unit: calendar days between the two expiries
max_expiry_gap_days.why: GOLDM expires on the 5th and the others at month-end, so a few days' difference has to be allowed to pair them at all.
